artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a finite set $A \subset \mathbb{Z}$ and an integer $n \geq 1$, let $nA = \{a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n : a_1, \ldots, a_n \in A\}$ denote the $n$-fold sumset. For a real number $K > 0$, define
$$f(n,K) := \sup\left\{ \frac{|nA|}{|A|} : A \subset \mathbb{Z} \text{ finite, } |2A| < K|A| \right\}.$$
The Plünnecke–Ruzsa inequalities yield the bound $f(n,K) \leq K^n$. Determine the true asymptotic growth rate of $f(n,K)$ as $n \to \infty$ (for fixed $K > 1$): improve the upper bound on $f(n,K)$, or construct examples showing this bound is essentially tight.
artifact.status_search_result: The question on the precise growth rate of f(n,K) = sup |nA|/|A| under the doubling assumption |2A| < K|A| is a known open problem in additive combinatorics. The Plünnecke–Ruzsa inequality gives f(n,K) ≤ K^n, and refining this remains an active area, with no published proof of a sharp asymptotic resolution found in the search.

status_evidence.title: The Plünnecke–Ruzsa Inequality: An Overview
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Plünnecke–Ruzsa inequalities giving |nA| ≤ K^n |A| under doubling K.
status_evidence.claim: The standard Plünnecke–Ruzsa upper bound f(n,K) ≤ K^n is the known bound; sharper asymptotics are not resolved.

status_evidence.title: An Analytic Approach to Cardinalities of Sumsets (Matolcsi, Ruzsa, Shakan, Zhelezov)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work refining cardinalities of higher sumsets under doubling assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: Sharpening of sumset cardinality bounds is the subject of ongoing recent research, supporting that the precise growth of f(n,K) is not fully settled.
